manual_notes: Selected UI specification combines conflicting generations of the list contract: an earlier requirement says complete popup governance fields must remain in the list and be prewarmed, while the final requirement mandates a lightweight list excluding those fields and detail fetched on demand. Actual backend and frontend implement the latter with paginated summary, on-demand detail and lazy modal components. Embedded mounting, locale context and generation-aware refresh are also supported. This is substantial delivered functionality with an unresolved aggregate specification contract; a human must identify superseded requirements before assigning strict full-scope completion. No abandonment inferred.
